To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
organic fertilizers have a positive effect on the soil chemical indicators and the soil fertility.
the combination of different organic amendments with lime had a significant positive influence on DOC concentration in soil.
the combination of different organic amendments and liming had positive effects on DOC, nitrogen and phosphorous accumulation in the topsoils.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the influence of different fertilizers on DOC content, and the results can be used for the development of a new strategy for soil management.
the importance of soil organic matter and its fractions in soil quality assessment and management.
a new approach to soil quality assessment based on the analysis of DOC and nutrient stocks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of organic fertilizers is beneficial for soil quality and the environment.
organic fertilizers can improve the soil fertility, especially in acid soils.
the use of organic fertilizers is beneficial to the soil, and the application of organic fertilizers to limed soil has a more positive effect.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of alternative organic amendments can be a promising tool to increase the soil organic carbon content and improve the soil chemical status.
the application of FYM and other organic fertilizers in limed soils can be a promising way to maintain the soil fertility and to reduce the use of mineral fertilizers.
the liming and organic fertilizer application had a positive effect on soil quality and nutrient status.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the application of organic amendments is an effective tool in maintaining soil fertility, and in particular the liming and FYM application.
organic fertilizers can be used as an alternative to chemical fertilizers.
application of organic amendments in the acid soil is not recommended.
